generate.intro.en: An ebook becomes an audiobook, read in a voice you choose.
generate.intro.cs: Z e-knihy vznikne audiokniha namluvená hlasem, který si vyberete.

generate.chargeNote.en: Narration is paid from your family's credit. If a job fails, you pay only for the part already made, and the book has to be started again.
generate.chargeNote.cs: Namluvení se platí z kreditu vaší rodiny. Když úloha selže, zaplatíte jen za už hotovou část a knihu je potřeba spustit znovu.

generate.upload.formats.en: EPUB, MOBI, or TXT — up to ~50 MB.
generate.upload.formats.cs: EPUB, MOBI nebo TXT — nejvýš asi 50 MB.

generate.upload.unsupported.en: Only EPUB, MOBI, or TXT files are supported.
generate.upload.unsupported.cs: Podporované jsou jen soubory EPUB, MOBI a TXT.

generate.language.intro.en: Tell us what language the book is in, and whether it should be translated.
generate.language.intro.cs: Uveďte, v jakém jazyce je kniha a zda ji chcete přeložit.

generate.language.sourceNote.en: The audiobook will be narrated in the source language.
generate.language.sourceNote.cs: Audiokniha bude namluvena v jazyce knihy.

generate.voice.intro.en: Preview each voice, then pick the one to narrate your audiobook.
generate.voice.intro.cs: Poslechněte si ukázky a vyberte hlas, který audioknihu namluví.

generate.voice.meta.en: {language} · {gender, select, male {Male} female {Female} other {Neutral}} · Google TTS
generate.voice.meta.cs: {language} · {gender, select, male {Mužský} female {Ženský} other {Neutrální}} · Google TTS
generate.voice.meta.note: Under a voice's name: language code, the voice's gender, the provider.

generate.voice.listTitle.note: Above the list of voices, under the voice model cards.

generate.tier.title.note: Above the cards for Chirp 3: HD and the Gemini TTS models.

generate.tier.preview.note: Badge on a model Google offers as a Preview.

generate.tier.previewHint.en: A preview model: Google may change it or withdraw it.
generate.tier.previewHint.cs: Zkušební model: Google ho může změnit nebo stáhnout.

generate.tier.unavailable.cs: V tomto jazyce není k dispozici

generate.tier.play.note: Button: plays a short sample of the model.

generate.tier.playLabel.note: For screen readers. {name} is a model name.

generate.tier.priceNote.en: The price shown is the most you pay. You pay only for what is actually made.
generate.tier.priceNote.cs: Uvedená cena je nejvyšší možná. Zaplatíte jen za to, co se skutečně vytvoří.

generate.voice.perChapterHint.cs: Nedá se stáhnout jako jeden soubor

generate.cover.title.en: Name it and give it a cover
generate.cover.title.cs: Pojmenujte ji a dejte jí obálku

generate.cover.intro.en: All of this can be changed afterwards.

generate.cover.book.note: Cover option: the cover inside the EPUB/MOBI file.

generate.cover.bookHint.en: From the file; made for you if it has none
generate.cover.bookHint.cs: Ze souboru; když žádnou nemá, vytvoří se

generate.cover.printTitle.en: Print the title on the cover

generate.quote.intro.en: Check the details and the price before you start.
generate.quote.intro.cs: Před spuštěním zkontrolujte údaje a cenu.

generate.quote.preparation.note: Quote line: getting the book's text ready for the voice (abbreviations, numbers, dialogue).

generate.quote.free.note: Price of the cover in the summary.

generate.status.notCharged.note: Under a failed narration when it cost nothing.

generate.status.chargedPartial.en: You were charged {amount} for the part already made; the rest of the reserved credit was released.
generate.status.chargedPartial.cs: Za již hotovou část vám bylo účtováno {amount}, zbytek rezervovaného kreditu byl uvolněn.
generate.status.chargedPartial.note: Under a failed narration that Google had already billed in part. {amount} is a formatted price like “$1.25”.

generate.status.blocks.note: Blocks are the small pieces of text narrated one at a time.

generate.status.perChapterNote.en: You chose one file per chapter, so there is no single file to download — the book is in your library.
generate.status.perChapterNote.cs: Zvolili jste samostatné kapitoly, takže není jeden soubor ke stažení — kniha je ve vaší knihovně.

generate.eta.minutes.en: {count, plural, one {About # minute remaining} other {About # minutes remaining}}
generate.eta.minutes.cs: {count, plural, one {Zbývá asi # minuta} few {Zbývají asi # minuty} other {Zbývá asi # minut}}

generate.eta.duration.note: duration is formatted like 1 h 20 min.

generate.translate.intro.en: A book becomes an audiobook in another language, read in a voice you choose.
generate.translate.intro.cs: Z knihy vznikne audiokniha v jiném jazyce, namluvená hlasem, který si vyberete.

generate.translate.from.note: Label of the source-language select in Translate a book.

generate.translate.into.note: Label of the target-language select in Translate a book.

generate.translate.sameLanguage.en: Pick a language other than the book's.
generate.translate.sameLanguage.cs: Vyberte jiný jazyk, než ve kterém je kniha.

generate.personalUse.long.en: This audiobook is based on the original work and is meant for personal listening — yours and your family's. Whether you may share it further or publish it depends on the rights to the original and the laws where you live.
generate.personalUse.long.cs: Tato audiokniha vychází z původního díla a je určená k osobnímu poslechu — vašemu a vaší rodiny. Zda ji smíte dál šířit nebo zveřejnit, záleží na právech k původnímu dílu a na zákonech ve vaší zemi.
generate.personalUse.long.note: A quiet note (not a warning) on the confirm step of Narrate a book and Translate a book.

generate.personalUse.episodeLong.en: This translation is based on the original work and is meant for personal listening — yours and your family's. Whether you may share it further or publish it depends on the rights to the original and the laws where you live.
generate.personalUse.episodeLong.cs: Tento překlad vychází z původního díla a je určený k osobnímu poslechu — vašemu a vaší rodiny. Zda ho smíte dál šířit nebo zveřejnit, záleží na právech k původnímu dílu a na zákonech ve vaší zemi.
generate.personalUse.episodeLong.note: The same note for Translate an episode, beside the price.

generate.personalUse.short.en: Based on the original work, for personal listening.
generate.personalUse.short.cs: Vychází z původního díla, k osobnímu poslechu.
generate.personalUse.short.note: Small text on a finished narration, translated book or translated episode.

generate.quote.credit.note: On the confirm step, for information: the server decides whether it is enough.

generate.tier.withdrawn.en: That voice model is no longer offered. Choose another.
generate.tier.withdrawn.cs: Tento hlasový model už není k dispozici. Vyberte jiný.
generate.tier.withdrawn.note: 400 naming voice_tier: the model was withdrawn meanwhile.

generate.cover.regenerate.note: On a finished narration: generate another cover, free.

generate.cover.regenerateLeft.en: {count, plural, one {# more free cover} other {# more free covers}}
generate.cover.regenerateLeft.cs: {count, plural, one {Ještě # obálka zdarma} few {Ještě # obálky zdarma} other {Ještě # obálek zdarma}}

generate.cover.useBook.note: Only when the uploaded file has a cover of its own.

generate.cover.working.en: Making the cover… this takes about half a minute.
generate.cover.working.cs: Obálka se vytváří… trvá to asi půl minuty.

generate.cover.error.notFinished.en: The book isn't finished yet, or it was deleted.
generate.cover.error.notFinished.cs: Kniha ještě není hotová, nebo byla smazána.

generate.cover.error.noBookCover.en: The book's file has no cover of its own.

generate.cover.error.limitReached.en: This book has used all its free covers.
generate.cover.error.limitReached.cs: Tato kniha už vyčerpala všechny obálky zdarma.

generate.cover.error.failed.en: The cover couldn't be made. Nothing was used up — try again in a moment.
generate.cover.error.failed.cs: Obálku se nepodařilo vytvořit. Nic se nespotřebovalo — zkuste to za chvíli znovu.

generate.cover.error.unavailable.en: Covers can't be made on this server right now.
generate.cover.error.unavailable.cs: Na tomto serveru teď obálky vytvářet nelze.

generate.cover.error.notFound.en: This narration isn't yours, or it no longer exists.
generate.cover.error.notFound.cs: Toto namlouvání není vaše, nebo už neexistuje.

generate.madeHere.title.note: Page title: everything you had narrated or translated.

generate.madeHere.empty.en: What you narrate or translate appears here: audiobooks from your ebooks, and podcast episodes in another language.
generate.madeHere.empty.cs: Zde se objeví, co namluvíte nebo přeložíte: audioknihy z vašich e-knih a epizody podcastů v jiném jazyce.

generate.madeHere.emptyTranslatedBooks.cs: Zde se objeví knihy, které přeložíte.
generate.madeHere.emptyTranslatedBooks.note: Mac: Translate a Book's list of translated books, when empty.

generate.madeHere.books.note: Section heading: narrated and translated books.

generate.madeHere.translatedBooks.note: Section heading on the Mac's Translate a Book page.

generate.madeHere.ready.note: A finished narration's state in the list.

generate.madeHere.failed.note: A failed narration's state in the list.

generate.madeHere.chooseItem.note: Mac: the detail column with nothing selected.

generate.madeHere.languages.note: A translation's two languages, by name.

generate.madeHere.details.note: Link from a row to the narration's own status page.

generate.madeHere.changeCover.note: Opens the cover actions of a finished book under its row.

generate.madeHere.older.note: Loads the next page of narrations.

generate.madeHere.error.en: Couldn't load what was made here.
